description: The file 'URL.cpp' contains implementation of URL-related functions such as URL encoding, decoding, Base64 encoding/decoding, and URL parsing within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It defines methods for handling components of URLs including scheme, domain, path, query, and fragment, and provides utility functions for URL transformations.

methods.name: uint16_t Encode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
methods.description: URL encoding function that percent-encodes special characters in the source string.

methods.name: uint16_t Decode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
methods.description: URL decoding function that converts percent-encoded sequences back to characters.

methods.name: uint16_t Base64Encode(const uint8_t * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength,const bool padding)
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: uint16_t Base64Decode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,uint8_t * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength,const TCHAR * ignoreList)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string back into binary data.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & urlStr)
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components: scheme, username, password, host, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: void ParseDomain(const Core::TextFragment & url)
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting hostname and port if present.

methods.name: string Text() const
methods.description: Reconstructs the full URL as a string from its components.

methods.name: uint32_t CopyFragment(TCHAR * destination,const uint32_t maxLength,uint32_t index,const string & data)
uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
